newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF seeking 190,000T of Chinese corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF seeking 190,000T of Chinese corn.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) is seeking 190,000 tonnes of Chinese corn for shipment between July to August, traders said on Tuesday.
A source said the NLCF is looking for the corn at below $141-$142 a tonne C&F -- the recent selling price for Chinese corn concluded by trader Toepfer.
Early last week, the Korea Feed Association (KFA) bought 120,000 tonnes of Chinese corn at $143.50 a tonne C&F from Toshoku Ltd through private negotiation, the source said.
The purchase was made in four 30,000-tonne cargoes for arrival by July 30, August 10, August 20 and August 30.
Since January, South Korean buyers have bought an estimated 810,500 tonnes of corn from China.
